headline.caveat: Oracle + MGX together hold ~20% of Stargate LLC; the individual split and Oracle's capital commitment are undisclosed

nature_md: Oracle is an initial equity funder of Stargate LLC (sharing ~20% with MGX; exact split undisclosed) and, more importantly, its principal delivery arm: Oracle contracts for and operates much of the Stargate capacity (Abilene with Crusoe, the five Sept 2025 sites with Vantage and others) and sells it onward to OpenAI under the ~$300B compute contract. Oracle's JV equity is small relative to the balance-sheet weight it carries as lessee/operator of Stargate campuses — the leases and its ~$70B FY27 capex, not the LLC stake, are where Oracle's real Stargate exposure lives.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: JV equity stake (undisclosed, presumably equity-method). The heavier items are elsewhere: Oracle's data-center lease obligations for Stargate sites (supporting the $16.3B Saline Twp and $38B Vantage debt packages priced off Oracle's credit) and its bond issuance ($18B + $25B) funding buildout capex.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Capital contribution to the LLC. Stargate's economics flow back to Oracle mainly as its role converts into OCI revenue via the OpenAI contract — equity in the vehicle, revenue from its output.
